verdict.rationale: OpenRouter offers a browsable catalog at openrouter.ai/models, titled "Compare AI Models: Pricing, Context & Benchmarks", which can be sorted by price. It also exposes a programmatic GET /api/v1/models endpoint, and its official MCP server can pull live model and price data. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the /api/v1/models response includes pricing and context-length fields (the evidence only says it lists slugs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the catalog metadata.
